decision: Chose sqlite_index because ADR 0001 requires the report cache to be an on-disk SQLite file and never only in process memory. Recorded Mira's 50 MB cache limit and the 1 GB kiosk RAM as new ADR 0005 in mira-app. Nothing was implemented or committed.

recorded.info: New ADR with Mira's verbatim words: the kiosk has 1 GB RAM and the report cache must never grow past 50 MB (covers memory and disk, index included). Also records the choice of the SQLite index over the in-memory LRU, per ADR 0001.
